response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The evidence indicates that the insured person developed acute gastroenteritis during their stay in the Czech Republic, which required medical treatment including hydration, dietary advice, and medication. Clause A4.1 covers the costs of outpatient treatment for acute illness during a trip, which applies here. There is no indication that the illness was pre-existing (A5.1), planned (A5.2), or related to alcohol, extreme sports, war, or terrorism (A11.1–A11.4)."}
